Typography

round(14 x 1.2^n): 12, 14, 17, 20, 24, 29, 35px. Weights body 400, label 400, heading 600.

headline.lg 35/44 600Page and section titles.
headline.md 29/36 600Page and section titles.
headline.sm 24/32 600Page and section titles.
title.lg 20/28 600Card, panel and group titles.
body.lg 17/24 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 17/24 600Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 14/20 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 14/20 400Button and control labels.
code.md 14/20 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 14/20 600Table headers, field-group titles.
body.sm 12/16 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 12/16 400Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 12/16 400Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 12/16 400Inline values, dense code rows.
